title: SparkMC
description: Ignite YOUR adventure in our unique Minecraft server. Join the fun in our Custom Factions or Full Vanilla Survival server, so much awaits you adventurer.
body:
# What Features does SparkMC have?

## FACTIONS:
✦ **Faction Wars:** Engage in thrilling faction raids, we have cannons ready to go for you to just lock and load. Claim your land, protect your base, and rise to the top!
✦ **Custom Economy:** With 3 different unique economies all seems to fit, but this is where we introduce item economy, to not just make everything obtainable with in-game money!
✦ **Challenge the Undead Gods:** Be the top damager on our undead gods and win their skull which u crack open to obtain ur rewards.
✦ **Battle the Swarms:** Fight against many undead ghouls and win unique rewards in the warzone.
✦ **Fun PvP:** Experience balanced and refined PvP combat with 1.8 combat mechanics and our custome enchants that feel vanilla minecraft like.
✦ **Regular Updates:** Enjoy frequent updates and new content that keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.
✦ **Events:** Frequent automatic events and even fully custom events once a month to keep the lore of the server fresh.
✦ **Tutorials:** Things too complex for you, we have prepared quick and easy to understand tutorials, where you even get a reward for listening!

Factions too much? Join survival and chill out, create a team to know your people

## SURVIVAL (full vanilla):
✦ Fight with other adventurers to stay the most dominant person on the server
✦ 100% vanilla server, excluding out custom events that bring much more meaning to survival
